key_insight: Frozen medical LLMs/VLMs can keep improving after deployment by learning from past cases through external skill, knowledge, and multimodal memory rather than by retraining model weights.
clinical_relevance: This could help clinical AI stay closer to evolving evidence and workflows while preserving visual details important for diagnosis and decision support.
method: Adds a learned Skill to guide reasoning and tool use.
Stores trusted case-based facts in a Knowledge Memory.
Keeps a Multimodal Knowledge Base of visual examples and uses a validation rule that only accepts updates that help new cases without hurting prior performance.
evidence_signal: Evaluated on six benchmarks across clinical diagnosis, workflows, reasoning, and visual reasoning with four base models, showing up to 34.2% improvement during online deployment.
watch_item: Because updates depend on external memories and online validation, deployment quality may still hinge on the reliability, coverage, and maintenance of stored cases and evidence.
paper_title: Frozen Models, Evolving Expertise: Model-Agnostic Learning from Deployment Experience for Multimodal Medical AI
